name: characters
sql: CREATE TABLE characters (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprints TEXT NOT NULL, seen_at TEXT NOT NULL, skills TEXT)

name: dungeon_runs
sql: CREATE TABLE dungeon_runs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL)

name: encounters
sql: CREATE TABLE encounters (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL)

name: identity_sightings
sql:
CREATE TABLE identity_sightings (character_id TEXT NOT NULL, object_id INTEGER NOT NULL, visit TEXT NOT NULL, seen_at TEXT NOT NULL, method TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (character_id, object_id, visit))

name: identity_sightings_object
sql: CREATE INDEX identity_sightings_object ON identity_sightings (visit, object_id)

name: identity_timeline
sql:
CREATE TABLE identity_timeline (character_id TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, visit TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT, object_id INTEGER, equipment TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (character_id, at, kind))

name: skill_weapons
sql: CREATE TABLE skill_weapons (skill INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, weapons TEXT NOT NULL)

name: unidentified_players
sql:
CREATE TABLE unidentified_players (member_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, record_id TEXT, object_id INTEGER NOT NULL, equipment TEXT,
    candidates TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, resolved_id TEXT, resolved_name TEXT, method TEXT, skills TEXT, visit TEXT)
